scripts.test:allure: playwright test && npm run allure:generate && npm run allure:open
scripts.start: playwright test && playwright show-report && allure generate ./src/reports/allure-results --clean -o ./src/reports/allure-report && allure open ./src/reports/allure-report
scripts.ciGitUI: npx playwright test --project=web || exit_code=$?; npx playwright generate-report && allure generate ./src/reports/allure-results --clean -o ./src/reports/allure-report && allure open ./src/reports/allure-report; exit $exit_code
scripts.ciGitAPI: npx playwright test --project=api || exit_code=$?; npx playwright generate-report && allure generate ./src/reports/allure-results --clean -o ./src/reports/allure-report && allure open ./src/reports/allure-report; exit $exit_code
